rules.cssText: .data-import-diagnostics { display: grid; grid-column: 1 / -1; gap: 5px; min-width: 0px; padding: 7px 8px; border-left: 3px solid var(--ux-danger); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ux-danger-soft, #fce8e8) 58%, transparent); }
